## 1. WLib Native Package Registration Architecture <a id="s1-architecture"></a>

### 1.1 Two-Table Registration Design (`DAT_141e51de0` and `[registrar + 0x08]`) <a id="s1-1-two-tables"></a>

The WLib Virtual Machine in `x64/lotroclient64.exe` bridges bytecode (`client_gamelogic.dat` record `0x56000000`) to native C++ subsystems through two distinct registration tables populated during engine and client initialization:

1. **Table A — `NativePackageDescriptor` Table (`DAT_141e51de0`, count `DAT_141e51de8`, capacity `DAT_141e51dec`):**
   - Populated via `RegisterNativePackageDescriptor` (`0x14037a770`), which inserts a `0x70`-byte `NativePackageDescriptor` sorted by `pkg_id` (`u32` at `+0x00`) into the global array at `DAT_141e51de0` and looked up by binary search in `LookupNativePackageDescriptor` (`0x1403d0120`).
   - Used whenever WLib bytecode executes opcode `0x0E` (`new.native <u32 pkg_id>`, handler `0x1403d04e0`), or when a C++ native function wraps/copies a native C++ object into a WLib heap reference (`0x140359dd0` `NewNativeByPkg`, `0x140359e40` `WrapNativePtr`, `0x140359f10` `CopyNativeByPkg`), or when `WLibArgFrame` (`0x008E0001` / `0x008E0006`) serializes/deserializes a native object across an RPC boundary (`0x140362b70` -> `desc->fn_serialize` at `+0x68`).
   - Contains **`258` registered `NativePackageDescriptor` entries**: **`151` base descriptors** registered in `RegisterBaseNativePackageDescriptors` (`0x14081b530..0x1408200cd`) and **`107` client descriptors** registered in `RegisterClientNativePackageDescriptors` (`0x140b293d0..0x140b2c862`).
2. **Table B — `NativeFunction` Hash Table (`[registrar + 0x08]`, linked into `DAT_141e51cf0`):**
   - Populated via `registrar->vtable[+0x50]` (`RegisterNativeFunc` at `0x14037a830`), taking `(registrar_rcx, uint32_t fn_id_edx, NativeFuncPtr fn_ptr_r8)` where `fn_id = (pkg_id << 16) | func_num`.
   - During `WLibVM::LinkBytecode` (`0x1403612f0`), every opcode `0x15` (`call.native <u32 (pkg_id << 16) | func_num>`) in the loaded bytecode has its `32`-bit immediate operand replaced in-place with an index into the flat resolved pointer array `DAT_141e51cf0` (`8` bytes per entry). At runtime, opcode `0x15` (`0x14035cf4f`) indexes `DAT_141e51cf0[idx]` and calls the C++ wrapper directly (`void __fastcall fn(uint32_t* stack_top_rcx, uint32_t* ret_slots_rdx)`).
   - Contains **`3,997` registered native functions** across **`449` function-bearing packages**: **`2,090` base functions** registered in `RegisterBaseNativeFunctions` (`0x140824c00..0x14082f813`, `192` packages) and **`1,907` client functions** registered in `RegisterClientNativeFunctions` (`0x140b9f3c0..0x140ba9043`, `257` packages).
   - Combined with `10` descriptor-only packages (`0x001B`, `0x0051`, `0x0052`, `0x0056`, `0x0058`, `0x005A`, `0x005C`, `0x005D`, `0x005F`, `0x01C0`), the binary defines **`458` total WLib native packages**: **`298` packages in `0x0001..0x01FF`** (`195` base in `0x0001..0x00E7` and `103` client in `0x0120..0x01FF`) and **`160` extended packages in `0x070A..0x16A4`** (`7` base and `153` client).

### 1.2 `NativePackageDescriptor` (`0x70` Bytes) and Heap Wrapper (`0x20` Bytes) Layouts <a id="s1-2-layouts"></a>

Every entry in `DAT_141e51de0` has the following `0x70`-byte (`112`-byte) layout:

| Offset | Size | Type | Field Name | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `+0x00` | `4` | `u32` | `pkg_id` | Package ID (`0x0004..0x16A4`, little-endian). Sort key for binary search in `0x1403d0120`. |
| `+0x04` | `4` | `u32` | `obj_size` | Byte size of the underlying C++ payload (`0` for static/stateless or external-pointer packages; `4..0x1044` for value/struct packages). |
| `+0x08` | `1` | `u8` | `flag_heap_alloc` | When `1`, `0x1403d04e0` allocates the C++ object via `fn_heap_new` (`+0x10`); when `0` and `obj_size > 0`, allocates in-place at `[wrapper + 0x20]` (`flags = 0x10000000`) and calls `fn_inplace_ctor` (`+0x28`). |
| `+0x09` | `1` | `u8` | `flag_refcounted` | Indicates external ref-counted C++ object lifecycle management. |
| `+0x0A` | `1` | `u8` | `flag_handle_only` | When `1`, allocated wrapper is a pure `0x20`-byte handle (`0x1403587e0`, `flags = 0x50000000`) whose `+0x18` `cpp_ptr` is populated by the caller. |
| `+0x0B` | `5` | `u8[5]` | `padding` | Zero padding to `8`-byte alignment. |
| `+0x10` | `8` | `ptr` | `fn_heap_new` | Heap allocator callback (`void* (*)(void)`). |
| `+0x18` | `8` | `ptr` | `fn_heap_copy` | Heap copy-constructor callback (`void* (*)(const void*)`). |
| `+0x20` | `8` | `ptr` | `fn_heap_delete` | Heap destructor/deallocator callback (`void (*)(void*)`). |
| `+0x28` | `8` | `ptr` | `fn_inplace_ctor` | In-place placement constructor (`void* (*)(void* inplace_buf)` at `[wrapper + 0x20]`). |
| `+0x30` | `8` | `ptr` | `fn_inplace_copy` | In-place copy constructor (`void* (*)(void* dst_buf, const void* src_buf)`). |
| `+0x38` | `8` | `ptr` | `fn_inplace_dtor` | In-place destructor (`void (*)(void* inplace_buf)`), invoked by `0x140357dc0` when the WLib reference is garbage-collected or freed. |
| `+0x40` | `8` | `ptr` | `fn_equals` | Equality comparison callback (`bool (*)(const void*, const void*)`). |
| `+0x48` | `8` | `ptr` | `fn_hash` | Hash code callback (`uint32_t (*)(const void*)`). |
| `+0x50` | `8` | `ptr` | `fn_serialized_size` | Returns serialized byte size (`uint32_t (*)(const void*)`). |
| `+0x58` | `8` | `ptr` | `fn_visit_refs` | GC reference traversal callback (`void (*)(void*, RefVisitor*)`) for container packages (`HashTable`, `SmartArray`, `DoublyLinkedList`, `WLibArgFrame`). |
| `+0x60` | `8` | `ptr` | `fn_remap_refs` | Reference remapping callback (`void (*)(void*, RefRemapper*)`). |
| `+0x68` | `8` | `ptr` | `fn_serialize` | Archive serializer (`void (*)(void** cpp_ptr_slot, Archive* ar)`), invoked by `0x140362b70` during `WLibArgFrame` (`0x008E0001` / `0x008E0006`) RPC marshaling. |

Every WLib object/native reference stored in the VM reference table (`DAT_141e51cd8`, indexed by `24`-bit reference ID `ref_id & 0x00FFFFFF`) points to a `0x20`-byte header:

| Offset | Size | Type | Field Name | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `+0x00` | `4` | `u32` | `flags_and_refcnt` | High nibble encodes allocation kind: `0x10000000` = single allocation of `0x20 + obj_size` bytes (`+0x18` points to `+0x20`); `0x50000000` = pooled `0x20`-byte native wrapper (`0x1403587e0`); `0x40000000` = WLib class instance (`+0x08` points to WLib class metadata). Low bits hold reference count / GC state. |
| `+0x04` | `4` | `u32` | `reserved` | Zero / alignment padding. |
| `+0x08` | `8` | `ptr` | `type_desc_ptr` | Pointer to `NativePackageDescriptor` (when native) or WLib class descriptor (when WLib class). |
| `+0x10` | `8` | `ptr` | `wlib_slots_ptr` | Pointer to WLib member variable slots (`NULL` / `0` for native package objects). |
| `+0x18` | `8` | `ptr` | `cpp_ptr` | Pointer to the underlying C++ object (`[wrapper + 0x20]` for in-place allocations, or external C++ pointer). Unwrapped by native functions via `*(void**)(*(uintptr_t*)(DAT_141e51cd8 + 8 * (ref_id & 0xFFFFFF)) + 0x18)`. |

### 1.3 Native Function Wrapper Calling Convention & Return Marshaling <a id="s1-3-calling-convention"></a>

Every registered `NativeFunction` has the x86-64 Microsoft `__fastcall` signature `void NativeWrapper(uint32_t* stack_top_rcx, uint32_t* ret_slots_rdx)`:

1. **Operand Stack Unpacking (`rcx`):** `rcx` points one `32`-bit slot past the top of the VM operand stack (`r12` in the VM loop). Arguments pushed left-to-right precede `rcx` at negative `4`-byte offsets (`[rcx - 0x04]`, `[rcx - 0x08]`, `[rcx - 0x0C]`, ...). Single-slot types (`int`, `float`, `bool`, `string` table ref, `object`/`native` ref) occupy `4` bytes (`1` slot); `64`-bit `long` (`ulong` / `EntityID`) occupies `8` bytes (`2` slots).
2. **Receiver Unwrapping (`DAT_141e51cd8`):** Instance methods on native packages read the receiver reference ID from the first pushed slot (highest negative offset `[rcx - 4*N]`), mask `ref_id & 0x00FFFFFF`, index `DAT_141e51cd8`, and dereference `+0x18` (`cpp_ptr`) to obtain the `this` pointer for the C++ call.
3. **Return Value Writing (`rdx`):** Void native functions leave `rdx` untouched. Value-returning functions write the return value into `[rdx + 0x00]` and the VM stack type tag into `[rdx + 0x04]`:
   - `tag = 0x02` (`int` / `bool` / `enum` `u32`): `[rdx] = eax`, `[rdx + 4] = 2`.
   - `tag = 0x01` (`float` `f32`): `[rdx] = xmm0`, `[rdx + 4] = 1`.
   - `tag = 0x04` (`long` / `EntityID` `u64`, `2` stack slots = `16` tagged bytes): `[rdx] = 0`, `[rdx + 4] = 4`, `[rdx + 8] = rax` (`64`-bit value), `[rdx + 12] = 0` (`high tag`).
   - `tag = 0x08` (`WLibString` / `StringInfo`): `[rdx] = str_ref`, `[rdx + 4] = 8`.
   - `tag = 0x10` (`Object` / `NativePackage` reference): wrapped via `0x140359dd0(pkg_id)` (`NewNativeByPkg`), `0x140359e40(pkg_id, cpp_ptr, ...)` (`WrapNativePtr`), or `0x140359f10(pkg_id, &stack_struct)` (`CopyNativeByPkg`), then registered in `DAT_141e51cd8` via `0x140358620`, storing `[rdx] = ref_id | 0x02000000`, `[rdx + 4] = 0x10`.

### 1.4 Client UI Notice Broadcasting (`SendNotice_*` Packages -> `0x140377260` -> `gm*UI` Subscribers) <a id="s1-4-notices"></a>

When a Server -> Client (`S->C`) WLib RPC stub (`0x8XXXXXXX`) dispatches to a client subsystem implementation class (`CXxxSystem::RecvCEvt_*`), the WLib method updates client state and invokes a client-tier native package (`0x012E..0x0168`, `0x0174..0x01FF`, or `0x070A..0x16A4`). Across `543` native functions in `103` packages (`452` unique `0x10000xxx` UI Notice IDs), the native wrapper calls a C++ notice-emitter helper in `0x140a45000..0x140b4c000` which:

1. Resolves the target `NoticeBroadcaster`: either the global UI notice broadcaster via `GetGlobalNoticeBroadcaster()` (`0x140814a90`, using `[rax + 0x40]`) or an entity-scoped broadcaster via `GetClientEntity(entity_id)` (`0x14074d760`, using `[entity + 0x98]`).
2. Loads a statically initialized `32`-bit **UI Notice ID (`0x10000001..0x1000085F`)** from the `.data` section (`0x141a10000..0x141a40000`) into `r8d`.
3. Packs any event parameters into a stack-allocated `UIEventNoticeData` payload struct (`r9`) and calls `NoticeBroadcaster::SendNotice(broadcaster_rcx, out_rdx, notice_id_r8d, payload_r9)` (`0x140377260`), which synchronously notifies all subscribed C++ `gm*UI` window controllers in `0x140bb0000..0x141140000` that reference the exact same `.data` `0x10000xxx` global variable (`100%` of emitted Notice IDs have their C++ subscriber/handler xrefs resolved in Section 2.3 and Section 3.2).

## 3. All `549` Server -> Client (`S->C`) WLib RPC Stubs (`0x8XXXXXXX`) <a id="s3-s2c-rpc"></a>

### 3.1 S->C WLib RPC Dispatch Architecture <a id="s3-1-s2c-dispatch"></a>

When the client receives a gameplay WLib RPC event packet over the network, `CWSLEvent::Execute` (`0x14051ec40`) extracts the `32`-bit RPC method ID `0x8XXXXXXX` (`(root_cid << 16) | 0x80000000 | fnum`) and the serialized `WLibArgFrame` payload (`pkg 0x008E`), resolves the target WLib subsystem or entity instance, and invokes `VM::CallVirtualIFun` (`0x1403cf400`).

Every one of the **`549` S->C RPC stubs** in `wlib.bin` executes the following standardized 5-step bytecode template:

1. **Type Guard (`0x00D60007`):** Calls `VMReflection::IsInstanceOf(this_ref, impl_cid)` (`0x00D60007`) where `impl_cid` is the concrete client subsystem class (e.g. `0x05D2` `CFellowshipSystem`, `0x0386` `CPlayerQuestList`, `0x0748` `CVendorSystem`). If `false`, returns immediately.
2. **Rewind `WLibArgFrame` (`0x008E000D`):** Calls `WLibArgFrame::ResetReadCursor(arg_frame)` (`0x008E000D`, C++ `0x14037b010`) so the cursor is positioned at offset `0` of the incoming network payload.
3. **Unpack Arguments (`0x008E0006`..`0x008E000A`):** Sequentially reads typed arguments from the `WLibArgFrame` onto the WLib stack:
   - `0x008E0006` (`ref`): Unpacks a WLib or Native Package object (`0x14037b230` -> `0x140362b70` -> `desc->fn_serialize` at `+0x68`).
   - `0x008E0007` (`i32`): Unpacks a `32`-bit integer/boolean/enum (`0x14037b170`).
   - `0x008E0008` (`i64`): Unpacks a `64`-bit integer / `EntityID` (`0x14037b020`).
   - `0x008E0009` (`f32`): Unpacks a `32`-bit IEEE-754 float (`0x14037b1d0`).
   - `0x008E000A` (`f64` / `str`): Unpacks a string / wide value (`0x14037b080`).
4. **Verify Read Completion (`0x008E000B`):** Asserts that no unread trailing bytes remain in the `WLibArgFrame` (`0x14037b120`).
5. **Dispatch to Client Handler (`0x16` `call.static` or `0x14` `call.virt`):** Calls the concrete client handler body `CXxxSystem::RecvCEvt_*`, which updates WLib state and calls client native packages (`0x012E..0x01FF`, `0x070A..0x16A4`) to emit `0x10000xxx` UI notices to subscribed `gm*UI` C++ classes.

## 4. All `619` Client -> Server (`C->S`) WLib RPC Stubs (`0x8XXXXXXX`) and `1,376` C++ -> WLib Call Sites <a id="s4-c2s-rpc-and-glue"></a>

### 4.1 C++ -> WLib Entry Points and C->S RPC Trigger Taxonomy <a id="s4-1-entry-points"></a>

C++ code in `x64/lotroclient64.exe` invokes WLib bytecode exclusively through three VM entry points (`1,376` total call sites in `.text`):

| Entry Point VA | Function Name | Signature | `.text` Call Sites | Role in Client |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `0x1403cf2b0` | `VM::CallStaticIFun` | `bool (uint16_t cid, uint16_t fnum, void* this_or_ref, WLibVal* args, uint32_t arg_cnt, WLibVal* ret)` | `1,372` | Used by all **`1,372` static `.glue` C++ wrapper functions** (`0x1403cc508..0x1403cf1f0` base, `0x140a96000..0x140aa3000` client pt 1, `0x140b4c000..0x140b9f3b0` client pt 2) called directly by C++ `gm*UI` windows and client subsystems. |
| `0x1403cf400` | `VM::CallVirtualIFun` | `bool (uint32_t method_id, void* this_or_ref, WLibVal* args, uint32_t arg_cnt, WLibVal* ret)` | `3` | Dispatches virtual WLib methods by `32`-bit ID: (1) `0x14051ec40` (`CWSLEvent::Execute` for incoming `0x8XXXXXXX` S->C RPC packets), (2) `0x1406ea5d0` and (3) `0x1406ea795` (`CommandParser` slash-command execution on `0x06C2`/`0x06C3` command subclasses). |
| `0x1403591f0` | `VM::CallVirtualByIndex` | `void (WLibObj* obj, uint32_t vslot_idx, ...)` | `1` | Called at `0x14051ef9f` (with helper `0x1403590fa`) to invoke a virtual method by vtable slot index. |

Every one of the **`619` C->S WLib RPC stubs (`0x8XXXXXXX`)** allocates a `WLibArgFrame` via `0x0E 0x0000008E` (`new.native 0x008E`), initializes it with the `32`-bit RPC ID `0x8XXXXXXX` via `0x008E000C`, packs arguments sequentially via `0x008E0001` (`ref`), `0x008E0002` (`i32`), `0x008E0003` (`i64`), `0x008E0004` (`f32`), and `0x008E0005` (`f64`/`str`), and transmits the frame to the server via Native Package `0x00D9` (`0x00D9000C` entity/system RPC, `0x00D9000D` routed RPC, or `0x00D90003` global service RPC). All `619` C->S RPC stubs (`100%`) are triggered through three pathways:

When a user or UI script executes a command, C++ `0x1406ea5d0` / `0x1406ea795` invokes `0x1403cf400` on the command object, which parses tokens via `0x00B6` and calls the `0x8XXXXXXX` C->S RPC stub.

## 5. Testable Invariants, Implementer Notes, and OPEN Callouts <a id="s5-invariants-and-notes"></a>

### 5.1 Testable Invariants & Synthetic Vectors <a id="s5-1-invariants"></a>

1. **Package Partition Invariant:** Every native package ID `pkg_id` in `0x0001..0x00E7` (`195` packages) is registered by the shared engine (`base` tier, `0x14081b530` / `0x140824c00`), and every `pkg_id` in `0x0120..0x01FF` (`103` packages) is registered by the client (`cli` tier, `0x140b293d0` / `0x140b9f3c0`). No package in `0x00E8..0x011F` is registered.
2. **Bytecode Linker Resolution Invariant (`0x1403612f0`):** Every `0x15` (`call.native <u32 fn_id>`) instruction in `client_gamelogic.dat` record `0x56000000` (`49,337` total sites across `692` unique `(pkg_id, func)` pairs) resolves in `RegisterBaseNativeFunctions` (`2,090` entries) or `RegisterClientNativeFunctions` (`1,907` entries), and every `0x0E` (`new.native <u32 pkg_id>`) instruction (`4,274` total sites across `81` unique `pkg_id` values) resolves in `DAT_141e51de0` (`258` descriptors).
3. **S->C vs. C->S RPC Disjointness Invariant:** Across the `117` root RPC classes (`CLS` entries owning `0x8XXXXXXX` method IDs), the `549` S->C RPC stubs (which call `0x008E000D` rewind + `0x008E0006..0A` unpack) and the `619` C->S RPC stubs (which call `0x008E000C` init + `0x008E0001..05` pack + `0x00D9` transmit) are strictly disjoint and partition all `1,168` `WLibArgFrame`-manipulating `0x8XXXXXXX` methods.
4. **Synthetic `WLibArgFrame` Test Vector:** A C->S call to `0x80210002` (`CFellowshipSystem` root `0x0021`, `fnum 2`, stub `0x5cfdc`) allocates `0x008E`, calls `0x008E000C(frame, 0x80210002)`, packs one `64`-bit `EntityID` (`0x008E0003`) and one `32`-bit `i32` flag (`0x008E0002`), and invokes `0x00D9000C(this, frame)`. An incoming S->C event `0x8021000D` (`stub 0x5d219`) verifies `0x00D60007(this, 0x05D2)`, rewinds the frame (`0x008E000D`), unpacks one `64`-bit `EntityID` (`0x008E0008`) and one `32`-bit `i32` (`0x008E0007`), verifies end-of-frame (`0x008E000B`), and calls `CFellowshipSystem::RecvCEvt_MemberAdded` (`Body 0x5d8d0`), which invokes `0x01340005` to broadcast UI Notice `0x1000012F` via `0x140377260`.

### 5.2 OPEN Callouts <a id="s5-2-open-callouts"></a>

None (`0` OPEN callouts — all `458` native packages, `3,997` registered native functions, `549` S->C RPC stubs, `619` C->S RPC stubs, `1,376` C++ -> WLib call sites, and `.data` `0x10000xxx` UI Notice ID -> C++ `gm*UI` subscriber class mappings are resolved).
